name: Surge

evidence.static: 03: managed static-file hosting on Surge's CDN; the customer uploads the built output

line: Publish static websites from a command line to Surge's CDN.

free.text: Free, no card; verify email before new surge.sh sites pause at 90 min

cells.regions: US, Canada, Europe, India, Asia-Pacific and Australia

work.math: $0 a month published Free subtotal. 100 MB, 1 million requests and 100 GB of data sent out fit only if the file count and publish timing meet the limits. Commercial permission and fair-use fit are unclear.
Surge does not provide a backend runtime for API execution.
Needs an external API host and separate PostgreSQL/backup service.
